features.title: Launching a file
features.expected_behavior: Launch a .png with the default handler; optionally show Open With; pick a file and launch it; warn before launching; launch with a view-size preference.

features.title: Launching a URI
features.expected_behavior: Launch the entered URI with the default handler; optionally Open With; warn before launching; launch with a view-size preference.

features.title: Receiving a file
controls: Create test file with no file extension (Button)
features.expected_behavior: Create a .alsdkcs test file (and an extension-less one) in the Pictures library; remove the created test files.

features.title: Receiving a URI
features.expected_behavior: Informational page describing how to activate the app via a custom URI scheme (alsdkcs:) or AppUriHandler; no interactive controls.

grading: Each feature scored pass/partial/fail on (a) structural control coverage in the WinUI 3 UIA tree, (b) behavioral liveness of controls, and (c) visual fidelity vs the UWP golden. score = round(100*(pass + 0.5*partial)/features_total).
